name: Neuroscience PhD (TAMIN)
detailsNote: Official annual deadline; Fall 2027 year not explicitly attached. Admission model and general funding not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Submit application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual; no applications created after deadline; incomplete document uploads remain possible.

applicationFee.note: TAMIN waivers only for US citizens/permanent residents meeting first-generation, disability, veteran or disadvantage criteria; email statement for review. International $90 not waived.

english.note: Within 2 years; Home Edition/Essentials 8.5 accepted, MyBest/IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted. GRE Verbal 146/GMAT alternatives subject to department approval. Exemption: listed English-country citizenship or US accredited bachelor/master; department may be stricter.

documents: All institution transcripts(unofficial review; official before class registration)
requirements.note: Select Interdisciplinary Degree Program/Neuroscience PhD in GraduateCAS. Statement explains neuroscience preparation, goals, motivation and relevant faculty. Central bachelor equivalent required. GRE policy not stated.

funding.note: Page lists Fall 2026 IDP Merit Fellowship limited to US citizens/permanent residents, first-time IDP applicants; not general PhD funding or an international guarantee. Main program funding page timed out.
